name: Example Brand
about: A made-up brand so every tool works before you add your own. Copy this folder to brands/<your-brand>/ and change it, or say "set up my brand" to Claude.
_colors: background: plain backgrounds. surface: cards. text: words on light. accent: tags and highlights. highlight: the box behind a keyword. good/bad: check marks and warnings. dark/dark_surface/on_dark: dark panels and the words on them.
_fonts: Each is a Mac system font name (lib/studio_config.py, SYSTEM_FONTS) or a file in this folder's fonts/ ("fonts/MyBrand-Bold.otf"). Fonts you bought stay out of git (brands/*/fonts/ is ignored).
_logo: A PNG with a transparent background in this folder, e.g. "logo.png". Used on end cards.
_captions: on_footage: "block" (words in a colour block) or "outline". keyword_style: "highlight" (box behind) or "color" (accent-coloured word).
_grade: warm, neutral or cool. Used by Hands-On Classic.
_never_use_as_background: Colour roles that must never fill a background, e.g. ["accent"].
_keep_out: Things that must never be on screen: other brands' logos, screens with private details, a sign that's out of date. Claude checks every cut against this list.
_effects: restrained: true = only quiet effects (paper-tear, typewriter, rack-focus...). favorites: effect names to reach for first.
